evidence.quote: Torres told the council she had lived on Elm Street for six years and wanted more information about parking and traffic before the change was approved.
She asked whether the city planned to add any new crosswalks near the affected blocks.
Owner Angela Torres said the shop will be open Tuesday through Sunday from 6 a.m. to 3 p.m.
Torres said she plans to source flour from a regional mill and rotate a few seasonal pastry options each month.
Torres said she chose the Fifth Avenue location because of its foot traffic and proximity to the elementary school.
The business is owned and operated by Angela Torres, who previously worked as an accountant before opening the bakery.
